clues.text: Reaching a top speed of 62 mph and standing 141 feet tall, this coaster turns riders upside down 7 times.
This coaster was engineered by manufacturer Gerstlauer and opened to the public in 2019.
You can find this thrilling indoor coaster inside a massive shopping and entertainment complex in New Jersey.
This coaster is famous for holding the world record for the steepest drop, plunging riders at an angle of 121.5 degrees.
The ride's name starts with a four-letter abbreviation for a quartet of crime-fighting reptiles and finishes with the name of their armored combat vehicle.

evidence.quote: TMNT Shellraiser is a steel indoor roller coaster at Nickelodeon Universe amusement park, within the American Dream mall, in East Rutherford, New Jersey, United States.
It is the steepest roller coaster in the world, with a vertical drop of 121.5 degrees.
It is based on ''Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles''. The ''Shellraiser'' is a vehicle used by the characters.
